text: This capstone course closes out the AI Engineer path. Instead of teaching a new piece, it's where everything you already know gets shipped as three real, working systems you build end to end and put your name on.

Three flagship projects: a production RAG knowledge assistant, an AI data analyst that turns questions into safe SQL and combines it with live API data, and a tool-using agent with human approval, security, and logging. A career-preparation chapter closes things out.

There's no fictional company here — you build this under your own name, in your own repository. Everything you've learned about LLMs, RAG, agents, and deployment feeds directly into these three builds.

Depth beats breadth. A GitHub profile with fifteen half-finished notebooks says you start things. Two or three complete, measured, deployed AI projects say you can finish them — and that's what gets you hired.

Four things make a project complete: a real end-to-end pipeline calling an actual LLM API, a measured evaluation with real numbers, a deployed and callable service, and a README that states your architecture and tradeoffs honestly.
Next: choosing which of the three projects to polish deepest, based on the role you're actually targeting.
